onset.Description: Start (s) of the trial's 9.002 s epoch within the concatenated file. Source epochs span -2.0 to +7.0 s (4609 samples at 512 Hz) relative to the onset of the first operand N1 (source D.time; trialsData_readme (data-structure description in Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19550714 raw_data.zip)), so N1 onset = onset + 2.0 s.

duration.Description: Length of one source epoch, 4609 samples / 512 Hz = 9.001953125 s.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: Integer event ID assigned by the BIDS writer (MNE-BIDS) to each trial_type; equals the trial index.

trial_type.Description: Positional trial index 'trial-NNN' = NNN-th trial (third dimension) of the source D.trials array, which is also row NNN of the source D.stimuliValues table. The stimulus content of each trial is in the columns N1, N2, N3, O1, O2, RT and stimType (since 30 Oct 2026).

N1.Description: First operand of the equation (source D.stimuliValues.N1, verbatim). Added 30 Oct 2026 from the sourcedata MAT tables.

RT.Description: Reaction time from the source table D.stimuliValues.RT, verbatim (the data README, trialsData_readme, gives RT in seconds).

stimType.Description: Difficulty and operand format of the trial (source D.stimuliValues.stimType, verbatim): easy or diff(icult), then ARAB (Arabic numbers), DICE (dice symbols), FING (fingers) or WORD (number words). Difficult equations use Arabic numbers only (Kalinova et al. 2026, Methods).
